question: Can current maximal blocks, their overlaps, and partnered parts support an exactly weighted unbiased reading of the next round of one fixed growth with held-out estimate spread under tenfold?
public_inputs: The literal start and reached roster, loose counts/parent counts or faithful equivalent, maximal blocks, and partner certificates. First unseen successors at the deepest archived stages of all fourteen unread starts, preserving their named labels and connection to earlier growth. Exact earlier stages and the partnered and finite-burst controls.
forbidden_inputs: No using the answer to choose a path weight or treating a zero-coverage proposal as exhaustive.

A factor-ten spread on replicates is an empirical precision observation, not automatically coverage of the true count. Do not trim failed or extreme runs, and do not choose a favorable final seed or order after reading it.
Do not hide randomization with a large additive constant or a rare correction to simulate precision. Count births only. Avoid using a shape witness as a population sample of all groups.
primary_observable: An actual probability sample within each specified growing end; explicit probability and expansion weight (or exact multi-stage inclusion weights), corrected to births and marked structural totals. Exact arithmetical or integer-weight route. On controls report signed observed error, theoretical bias, empirical central 95% range and denominators. Structural marks include maximal-block crossing and participation in partnered parts with stated coverage.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Order 3/4/5 partnered stages with known free/held transversals, start-04 at age eight with 304,590 next births, and the closed six-junction start-00 including genuine pre-tail and single-block control. Also calibrate age seven of start-03: 28,065 births.
first_executable_signal: Independently validate the stage inputs and exact support of the proposal on a small control before running fresh start-03 replicates.
resource_budget: Use the funded single-stage law. Factor exact components or recognized classes, sample residuals. Design against archived or exploratory results, then lock one sampling specification, batch size, seeds, alternate order and controls before its fresh validation. Use at least 24 independent replicates for start-03, empirical 2.5th/97.5th (linear interpolation), both zero counts and heavy tails visible. Apply the selected reading to every other unread stage, retaining their own bounds when precision differs. Computational impossibility requires a theorem with specified constraints; a finite trial cannot prove it.
decision_or_followup_rule: An independent fixed held-out panel with empirical central 95% spread under tenfold for start-03's round nine, or a true impossibility argument. Carry out controls and all thirteen other applications in either event. Make unresolved accuracy or evidence explicit.
stop_rule: An independent fixed held-out panel with empirical central 95% spread under tenfold for start-03's round nine, or a true impossibility argument. Carry out controls and all thirteen other applications in either event. Make unresolved accuracy or evidence explicit.
